The front-end framework AngularJS is also perfect for developing single-page applications (SPAs), which display all features and information on a single page. You can use MEAN to create the following websites: ● Single-Page Applications MEAN is an excellent tool for developing single-page applications (SPAs), including social networking, content management, and e-commerce apps. SPAs must provide dynamic, frequently tailored changes without users reloading the page. Angular’s component-based architecture, templating, and two-way data binding make creating dynamic views easier. Based on how visitors interact with the website, you may adjust your user interface (UI) in real time to suit their tastes. Moreover, you may improve the user experience by combining Angular with Express.js. Express.js offers the middleware and routing to manage client requests and facilitate database or external service communication, while Angular dynamically generates the user interface (UI). ● Real-Time Web Applications Building real-time web apps, including gaming websites, chat programs, and teamwork tools, is another great use case for the MEAN stack. Node.js’s asynchronous I/O paradigm makes real-time data processing possible. It also provides web sockets to simplify data transfer between the client and server and eliminate the need for repetitive HTTP queries. Apps can send real-time updates and messages thanks to this constant connection. When a user sends a message in a chat program, the server instantaneously broadcasts it to the designated recipient, providing an all-but-invisible benefit of the persistent connection. ● Data-Intensive Applications MEAN is also well-suited to the needs of data-intensive processes, which power applications such as e-commerce platforms and financial software. Node.js is a good choice for processing and handling huge volumes of data while maintaining performance. Meanwhile, MongoDB excels at processing massive, complex datasets. Additionally, it can read and write to the database, which is essential for applications that need to save, update, and retrieve data fast.
